Start a project

We make brands people remember.

Studio Kiln is an independent creative agency in Amsterdam. We design brand identities, websites and campaigns for companies that would rather be loved than ignored.

See our workStart a project

Clients include

Oat & CoMarlowePepper & PineNorrlandVélo Club

Selected work

A few projects from the last two years. Each one started with the same question: what should people feel when they see this?

Norrland Travel

App design, brand refresh

Marlowe Bank

Digital product, UX

Pepper & Pine

Packaging, identity

Vélo Club

E-commerce website

What we do

Small senior teams, usually three to five people, working directly with your founders or marketing lead.

Brand identity

Name, logo, colours, type and a voice that sounds like you. Delivered with brand guidelines your team will actually open.

  • Brand strategy
  • Logo & visual identity
  • Brand guidelines

Websites

Fast, easy-to-edit websites that look as good on a phone as on a big screen, and turn visitors into customers.

  • Web design
  • Webflow & Shopify builds
  • UX writing

Campaigns

Launch ideas, social content and short videos with a clear story, made for the platforms your audience uses.

  • Campaign concepts
  • Social & video content
  • Art direction

Packaging

Boxes, bottles and labels that stand out on a crowded shelf and work for printers and factories.

  • Packaging design
  • Illustration
  • Print production

"Kiln gave us a brand our customers talk about. Sales in our first year beat the plan by 40%."

Ines Vermeer
Founder, Pepper & Pine

Awards

# Creative Agency

Creator: mmrahmanbappi
Source: https://github.com/mmrahmanbappi/100-free-html-templates/blob/bab6ec6c8900450aab90989d217942a67ad9b16d/business/creative-agency/index.html

Extract the ZIP and open index.html. No build, npm dependencies or remote CDN is required.

The upstream/ folder preserves original source with its MIT notice. Root index.html is the separately documented MigBits adaptation.

Replace fictional sample business content, connect your own backend and retain the included license notices. Forms, data and payments are demonstrations.

Use Pause motion or your operating system reduced-motion preference. Full production and accessibility review remains your responsibility.

Original single-file HTML/CSS/inline JavaScript retained separately with creator MIT notice.

Stock photography, external fonts, favicons, metadata and remote services are excluded from the runnable edition; original HTML references are preserved as text only.

Original MigBits geometric demo artwork and motion controls are separate adaptations. Forms and checkout are frontend demonstrations, not backend services.

No React conversion is claimed. System font fallback changes the upstream typography. Render validation is not a complete accessibility audit.

Mobile grid minimum widths and word wrapping are corrected for community-center and nonprofit-charity. Dynamic photo references and initially empty image viewers use original artwork.

The original download-promotion toolbar is removed from runnable pages; creator attribution and complete copyright notices remain. Photo credit labels reflect the replacement MigBits artwork.
